Maria: quick flagging — ran a sweep this morning to tune per-GPU token-cap targets across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 with kernel-selector v2 enabled. L4 p99 latency spiked ~28% when KV cache fragmentation >22%. profile excerpt:

Maria: ```
model: redwood-v2
hw: L4
kernel: sel-v2
kv_frag: 0.23
p50: 62ms
p95: 210ms
p99: 780ms
batch_window_ms: 12
tokens_per_batch: 8200
``` 

Maria: flamegraph here: https://phab/internal/flame/526480 (private)
Maria: question: thoughts on lowering L4 token-cap to 6000 or changing queue policy to prioritize low-kv-frag slices? :thinking:

Raj: +1 on lowering token cap for L4. suggestion: try 5k then 6k for a/b. also enable `prefetch_warmup=true` for L4, that helped in the A100 experiments.

Raj: config snippet to try:

Raj: ```json
{"gpu_policy": "per-card",
 "L4": {"token_cap": 5000, "slice_hysteresis_ms": 30, "prefetch_warmup": true},
 "fallback_kernel": "sel-v1"}
```

Leo: can we correlate with kernel-selection logs? if sel-v2 falls back to sel-v1 often when kv-frag high, that explains p99. grep for `kernel_fallback` in the profiler output.

Anna: we saw similar regression with mixed-packing earlier — setting `slice_hysteresis_ms=30` and lowering packing_ratio for L4 reduced jitter. worth trying before a full rollout.

infra-bot: experiment summary (run id: exp-2026-03-18-09): A10/T4/A100 unaffected; L4: p99 +26% at token=8200; p99 +4% at token=6000; KV frag threshold crossing at ~22% correlated w/ sel-v2->sel-v1 fallback.

deploy-bot: canary created: canary/kvcap-l4-2026-03-18 (3 nodes L4). rolling window 15min. ping @maria when you want to promote or rollback.

Maria: thanks — I'll push config with token_cap=5000 + slice_hysteresis=30 to the canary and watch p99 for 30m. tagging @raj @anna for quick eyes.

Leo: I'll upload kernel logs to the experiment ticket. short term: prefer conservative cap (5k) + hysteresis. long term: need kernel-side quantization to reduce frag.

Maria: noted. will report back with 30m canary metrics. :thumbsup:
